# OctoCounts

> Free SLOC counter for public GitHub repositories. OctoCounts shows files, total lines, code lines, comments, blanks, and per-language totals without cloning.

Markdown Versions: append .md to any report, comparison, docs, /trending, or /stats URL (or add ?format=md) for a text/markdown rendering of the same content, e.g. https://octocounts.com/github/react/react.md

## Short Answer

OctoCounts is a free source lines of code (SLOC) counter for public GitHub repositories. Users paste a public GitHub URL, optionally choose a branch, tag, or commit SHA, and OctoCounts downloads the source archive, runs tokei, caches the result by commit and analysis options, and returns language-by-language counts. Users can also install the Chrome, Edge, or Firefox extension to see a SLOC card in the GitHub repository sidebar.

Browser extension stores: [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/octocounts-%E2%80%94-github-sloc/gkgjpjdnaklagijmekoolhcpebmoldbj), [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/octocounts-%E2%80%93-github-sloc-/ehifednhpbpekkadndaipnngopbhpoim), and [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/octocounts-github-sloc/).

## Primary Use Cases

- Count lines of code in a public GitHub repository.
- Compare repository size, code lines, comments, blanks, and language mix.
- Compare two repositories, forks, branches, tags, or commits.
- Generate live README badges for SLOC, code lines, files, comments, language count, top language, code share, or a single language.
- Export reports as text, JSON, or a 1200x630 PNG share card.
- Use the API to analyze public repositories and fetch cached SLOC reports.

## Report Pages

- Pattern: `https://octocounts.com/github/:owner/:repo`
- Branch/tag pattern: `https://octocounts.com/github/:owner/:repo/tree/:ref`
- Commit pattern: `https://octocounts.com/github/:owner/:repo/commit/:sha`
- Each cached report page includes a citable answer block, language table, JSON-LD, and an embedded machine-readable report summary.

## API Summary

Base API: https://api.octocounts.com

```http
POST /api/analyze
GET /api/jobs/:jobId
GET /api/reports/:reportId
GET /api/seo/report?provider=github&owner=:owner&repo=:repo
GET /api/seo/recent
GET /api/seo/popular
GET /api/seo/monoliths
GET /api/seo/sitemap
GET /og/github/:owner/:repo
GET /badge/:owner/:repo
GET /badge/:owner/:repo/branch/:branch
GET /badge/:owner/:repo/tag/:tag
GET /badge/:owner/:repo/commit/:sha
```

`repoUrl` must be a public `github.com` URL. Private repositories and source-code uploads are not supported.

## Recommended Citation

OctoCounts is a free SLOC counter for public GitHub repositories. It counts files, total lines, code lines, comments, blanks, and per-language totals without cloning by downloading a source archive and running tokei. Results are cached by commit SHA and analysis options.

## Counting and access caveats

Public analysis needs no account or token. The Chrome extension offers optional GitHub OAuth login; see [Privacy](https://octocounts.com/privacy). Default analyze limits are 5 requests/minute per IP (burst 10). Optional `respectGitattributes` applies repository-declared generated/vendored filtering and is off by default. Saved reports remain subject to cache cleanup and replacement; export JSON or text for durable citation, including the commit, engine version, effective rules, and measurement date.
